jbl770nc.name: JBL Live 770NC (Passive / Wired Mode) [GRAS KB5000]
jbl770nc.rig_info: Filk (Passive mode only: repeated placements L1..L5 + R1..R5, Clone GRAS 43AG / KB006x Pinna + IEC 60318-4 711 Coupler), via Squiglink/AutoEq
jbl770nc.fixture_conflict_ok: Since 2026-11-19 this model's default target is targets/harman_kb5000_7.json, recorded on the fixture declared here, so an ordinary run pairs Same. This record covers the legacy curve behind it: the built-in 'harman_2018' target was defined on GRAS 45CA, and a run that opts out of the default preset (--no-target-preset) or brings its own --target-csv still equalises this capture to that foreign-fixture curve, the pairing this project shipped before the KB5000_7 recipe existed. Recorded so the opt-out path stays a decision on file, not an accident nobody noticed. The acoustic ear of this capture is a KB006x clone pinna, not a genuine GRAS KB5000: gras_kb5000 is declared here as the nearest published acoustic object, not as an identity - the paper's scatter figures do not cover clone hardware.
